name: The Ancients
blurb: Read fifteen passages from Plato, Xenophon, Plutarch, Thucydides and Aristotle in exact public-domain translations, and learn their hard words, central ideas, and the people and history behind them.

sources.t: Project Gutenberg: Plato tr. Jowett, Xenophon tr. Dakyns, Thucydides tr. Crawley, Plutarch tr. Dryden rev. Clough
Nicomachean Ethics, tr. F. H. Peters, Standard Ebooks
Aristotle's Politics, tr. Benjamin Jowett (Clarendon Press), Internet Archive
The Works of Aristotle, vol. XI: Rhetorica, tr. W. Rhys Roberts (1924), Internet Archive
